items.title: [ESPÍRITO SANTO] Flutter Developer na BRAJAN SISTEMAS
items.description:
# [NOVA VENÉCIA - ES] Flutter Developer na Brajan Sistemas

## Descrição da vaga

A **Brajan Sistemas** está em busca de um(a) **Flutter Developer (Júnior/Pleno)** para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento.

Você fará parte do time responsável pela evolução de aplicativos corporativos voltados para gestão empresarial, desenvolvendo novas funcionalidades, integrações e melhorias em soluções utilizadas diariamente por empresas de diversos segmentos do varejo.

Se você gosta de desenvolver aplicações modernas, possui vontade de aprender e deseja trabalhar em projetos reais com grande impacto, essa oportunidade é para você.

## Local

* Remoto, Híbrido ou Presencial
* Vitória - Espírito Santo

## Benefícios

* Ambiente colaborativo e focado em inovação
* Oportunidade de crescimento profissional
* Participação em projetos de grande relevância
* Flexibilidade de trabalho (conforme modalidade)

#### Diferenciais

* Participação em projetos de ERP utilizados por centenas de empresas
* Contato com diversas tecnologias e integrações
* Equipe experiente e colaborativa
* Possibilidade de crescimento dentro da empresa

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**

* Experiência de 1 a 3 anos com desenvolvimento Flutter
* Conhecimento sólido em Dart
* Experiência com consumo de APIs REST
* Conhecimento em Git
* Boa lógica de programação
* Facilidade para trabalho em equipe

**Diferenciais:**

* Experiência com sistemas ERP
* Conhecimento em arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture)
* Conhecimento em integração com dispositivos e recursos nativos

## Contratação

CLT ou PJ (a combinar)

## Nossa empresa

A **Brajan Sistemas** desenvolve soluções ERP para supermercados, padarias, atacados, distribuidoras, farmácias, autopeças, restaurantes e diversos outros segmentos do varejo.

Estamos constantemente investindo em novas tecnologias para oferecer produtos modernos, robustos e de alta qualidade aos nossos clientes.

Conheça mais em: [](https://www.brajan.com.br/)

## Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo para **curriculo@brajan.com.br** com o assunto:

**Vaga Flutter Developer**

**Importante:** Favor informar sua **pretensão salarial** no e-mail.

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

Nosso processo seletivo costuma retornar aos candidatos em até **15 dias** após a candidatura.

## Labels

* Flutter
* Dart
* Júnior
* Pleno
* CLT
* PJ
* Remoto
* Híbrido
* Presencial

Job Details

CNO Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: CNO) is a leading insurance and financial services company focused on securing the future of middle-income America. Through brands such as Bankers Life, Colonial Penn, and Washington National, CNO delivers life and health insurance, annuities, financial services, and workforce benefits to more than 3.3 million policyholders, supported by $38.3 billion in total assets.

With a strong financial foundation, national presence, and a culture rooted in integrity, excellence, and people-first values, CNO offers meaningful opportunities for professional growth and impact across its U.S. locations, including its headquarters in Carmel, Indiana.

To be eligible for consideration, candidates must currently possess unrestricted authorization to work in the United States.  Please note that the Company does not intend to sponsor work visas with respect to this position or future full-time employment opportunities.

This is a paid internship at competitive rates.  Memorial Day and 4th of July holidays are paid days off.

CNO Financial Group is hiring a Cyber Security Intern to work alongside our experienced Cyber Security associates, assisting with professional Cyber Security day-to-day work. The Cyber Security Intern will spend time with various teams in Security, including Operations, Engineering, and Governance.

What you can expect:

    Exposure to enterprise cybersecurity operations and Security Operations Center functions.
    Hands-on experience with industry-leading security tools and technologies.
    Mentorship from experienced cybersecurity professionals.
    Practical experience supporting incident response and threat detection activities.
    Opportunities to develop technical, analytical, and professional skills.
    Experience working in a collaborative enterprise IT environment.

What you need (Minimum requirements):

    Progress towards a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related discipline.
    Status as a rising junior or rising senior, approx. graduation dates of December 2027-June 2029.
    Availability to work 40 hrs/week for 10-12 weeks during the summer.
    Candidate location in Central or Eastern US time zone is preferred OR willingness to work Central or Eastern time zone business hours.
    Basic understanding of information technology concepts, including networking and operating systems.
    Familiarity with cybersecurity principles and best practices.
    Ability to analyze information and identify patterns or anomalies.
    Strong organizational and documentation skills.

What will set you apart (Preferred experience):

    Previous internship, work experience, or academic projects related to cybersecurity or information technology.
    Familiarity with security concepts such as phishing, malware, endpoint security, authentication, and network security.
    Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python or PowerShell.
    Participation in cybersecurity clubs, competitions, labs, or Capture-the-Flag (CTF) activities.
    Pursuit of entry-level cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC, or similar.
    Balancing education and a part-time job during the school year.

The CNO 2027 internship program will run May 17 through August 06, 2027.

CNO Financial Group offers the following activities for this internship that complement the learning provided by the department work:

    Networking

    Leader Talks
    Career Counseling
    Development Opportunities
    Insurance Product and Industry Presentation Series
    An in-person event at one of our corporate offices during one week of the internship program
    Final Presentations
    Volunteering Event

During the summer at CNO, Interns are eligible for:

    Paid time to engage in Business Resource Group events.
    The CNO Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
    Onsite fitness centers.
    Active & Fit Direct national fitness center discount program.
    Marathon Health webinars.
    Utilizing a free code for the Monumental Marathon entry.

CNO supports a flexible work environment and encourages Associates to work where they are most productive. This position may work fully remote from any US-based location, provided they are able to work Central or Eastern Time hours. All work must be performed within the United States, and occasional travel to corporate offices may be required.

Associates living within 60 miles of a corporate office (Carmel, IN; or Chicago, IL) have access to work from that location as needed.

This is a newly created leadership position and a key member of the Vietnam leadership team, responsible for driving revenue growth, building strategic partnerships, and strengthening our market presence across Vietnam. 

Key Responsibilities 
● Lead and manage all Business Development/Key Account team members across Vietnam 
● Drive revenue growth and achieve business performance targets across all customer segments 
● Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with key enterprise clients, partners, and stakeholders worldwide in multi-regions 
● Expand the company's presence within Chinese and Vietnamese business ecosystems 
● Drive operational excellence, sales governance, forecasting, and pipeline management 

Requirements 
● Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or related fields 
● Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in sales, business development, or commercial leadership roles 
● At least 3 years of proven experience managing and leading sizable teams 
● Working proficiency in Mandarin, English, and Vietnamese 


Contact me for more details (interview process, benefits,...)

items.title: [Talent Calling]_Carbon Data Analyst
items.description:
Company Introduction
Our mission is to enable every organization to be climate conscious and positive with the world’s best climate software and data products, creating an all-in-one platform that allows organizations to measure, analyze, and reduce their Enterprise Carbon Footprint. 

Responsibilities
•	Communicate clearly with clients on data gaps and obstacles in the carbon footprinting process.
•	Transform data in excel to adapt to necessary requirements.
•	Collaborate closely with the internal carbon accounting experts. 
•	Develop an understanding of different carbon accounting calculation methodologies and input data types. 
•	Optimize processes to become more efficient with time. 
•	Support time zones of global customers (USA, Europe, Japan, Singapore, etc.)

Qualifications 
•	High level of Excel proficiency. 
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a high proficiency in English and a high degree of attention to detail.
•	Project management experience and ability to meet deadlines. 
•	Capable of successfully working multiple projects simultaneously.
•	Experience in gathering, formatting, and visually representing data.


Contact me for more details (interview process, benefits,...)

items.description:
Our client, a 100% Vietnamese technology company that specializes in turnkey solutions and the formation of highly skilled development teams for businesses of all sizes and industries. 

I. What You’ll Do 
• Enrich a wide range of structured and unstructured data into high-quality datasets for quantitative analysis and financial engineering. 
• Enhance data quality and integrity by developing validation tools and frameworks to measure the effectiveness of data enrichment pipelines. 
• Develop a deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and emerging AI/LLM applications, and analyze the underlying dynamics and behaviors within the data. 
• Provide technical support for global researchers, including diagnosing root causes of technical issues, troubleshooting Python and C++ code, and proposing scalable fixes and improvements. 
• Investigate, debug, and resolve issues in C++ applications and data pipelines, with a strong focus on performance, stability, correctness, and maintainability. 
• Explore and apply AI/LLM-based solutions to improve data processing, workflow efficiency, troubleshooting, documentation, and research support processes. 

II. What We’re Looking For 
• Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, AI, or related technical domains. 
• Practical experience with, and theoretical understanding of, deep neural networks, machine learning techniques, and modern AI approaches. 
• Demonstrated ability to implement data science pipelines and real-time applications in Python and C++. 
• Strong experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and improving C++ code, including performance analysis, root cause investigation, and code maintainability. 
• Familiarity with AI/LLM tools and applications, including using large language models to support analysis, automation, technical troubleshooting, or workflow optimization. 
• Proficiency with Python-based tools such as Jupyter Notebook and coding standards such as PEP 8. 
• Proficiency with C++ tools and concepts such as STL, object-oriented programming, and debugging best practices. 

Nice to Have 
• Experience as a data scientist or data engineer in finance or investment-related environments. 
• Experience with Linux/Unix shell, Git, and software debugging tools. 
• Experience applying AI/LLM technologies in engineering, analytics, data enrichment, support automation, or developer productivity use cases. 
• Experience optimizing or troubleshooting C++ - based systems in production or research environments. 

Workplace 
• Competitive salary, 13th-month salary, and performance-based bonuses. 
• Comprehensive healthcare package, including statutory and accident insurance. 
• Meal allowance and additional benefits for marriage, newborn, bereavement, and other life events. 
• Modern workplace with a fully stocked pantry and all necessary working equipment provided from day one. 
• Employee support fund for personal loans (e.g., housing, vehicle, education). 
• Clear career development opportunities in a fast-growing technology company.

items.title: 🗽[ $ 3,040 ] AI Developer [4+ yoe] - HN - Domain Edtech
items.description:
2+ yoe LLM | Đã trực tiếp vận hành ít nhất 1 hệ thống AI chạy production có người dùng thật | Domain Edtech | TA lưu loát | Upto 80tr/tháng.

**MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC**

1. Sở hữu mảng AI của sản phẩm
Chịu trách nhiệm chính về kiến trúc, chất lượng và hiệu quả của toàn bộ các tính năng AI trên nền tảng.
Cùng Founder xác định roadmap AI: làm bài toán nào trước, làm đến đâu, đo bằng chỉ số gì.
Trực tiếp code những phần khó nhất, không chỉ thiết kế trên giấy.

2. Agentic AI & hệ thống multi-agent (trọng tâm của vị trí)
Thiết kế và phát triển hệ thống multi-agent: nhiều agent chuyên biệt phối hợp để thực thi trọn vẹn một nghiệp vụ — không dừng ở việc trả lời câu hỏi.
Triển khai function calling / tool use và tích hợp MCP (Model Context Protocol) để agent thao tác trực tiếp trên hệ thống, dữ liệu và công cụ bên ngoài.
Xây dựng agent memory (short-term / long-term), state management, orchestration và cơ chế human-in-the-loop ở những điểm cần người duyệt.
Phát triển agent có khả năng reasoning, planning, self-correction (ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Reflection) và tự phục hồi khi gặp lỗi.
Xây dựng và tối ưu pipeline RAG cùng cơ chế xử lý học liệu phục vụ kiến trúc agentic.

3. Vận hành ở quy mô production
Lựa chọn mô hình AI phù hợp cho từng tác vụ, cân đối giữa chất lượng đầu ra và chi phí vận hành.
Thiết lập cách đo lường và kiểm soát chất lượng đầu ra của AI.
Đảm bảo hệ thống chạy ổn định, nhanh và không gián đoạn khi lượng người dùng tăng.
Đảm bảo an toàn dữ liệu người học và tuân thủ quy định bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân tại các thị trường triển khai.

4. Dẫn dắt đội ngũ
Định hướng chuyên môn, review code và đặt chuẩn kỹ thuật cho các thành viên trong mảng AI.
Mentor và onboard Junior/Middle AI Engineer khi team mở rộng.
Cùng Founder đánh giá chuyên môn ứng viên trong quá trình tuyển dụng.
Phối hợp với team Product, Frontend, DevOps và đội ngũ chuyên gia giáo dục.
